# useConfirmDanger

Danger confirmation: returns `confirm(options)`, which resolves to true when the user confirms. Irreversible
actions (deleting, clearing data) can require typing the name of the object before confirming. Must be used
inside `<App>`.

**Interaction**: when the dialog opens, focus is on "Cancel" (pressing `Enter` does not confirm by accident);
when a name is required, focus is in the input and "Confirm" stays disabled until the name matches. `Tab`
cycles inside the dialog, `Esc` cancels, and focus returns to the element that was focused before opening.

**Category**: Feedback · **Common uses**: Irreversible actions such as deleting, clearing data, transferring ownership or disbanding a team

## Import

```ts
import { useConfirmDanger } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Signature

```ts
useConfirmDanger(): (options: ConfirmDangerOptions) => Promise<boolean>
```

## Basic usage

Irreversible actions can only be confirmed after typing the name.

```tsx
import { Button, useConfirmDanger } from 'vellum-ui'

export function Basic() {
  const confirm = useConfirmDanger()
  return (
    <Button
      tone="danger"
      onClick={async () => {
        const ok = await confirm({
          title: 'Delete project',
          description:
            'The tasks, documents and member permissions of this project are deleted with it, and cannot be restored.',
          confirmText: 'Website redesign',
          okText: 'Delete',
        })
        if (ok) {
          // Delete the project
        }
      }}
    >
      Delete project
    </Button>
  )
}
```

## Types

Types of this library used above. Import them with `import type { … } from 'vellum-ui'`.

### ConfirmDangerOptions

Options of a danger confirmation: what is passed to the `confirm` function returned by useConfirmDanger.

| Field | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` | Title of the dialog, naming the action, such as "Delete project". | — | Yes |
| `description` | `ReactNode` | The consequences: what is deleted and whether it can be restored. | — | Yes |
| `confirmText` | `string` | Text the user must type before "Confirm" is enabled, usually the name of the object (compared exactly, case-sensitive). Without it, a click on "Confirm" is enough. | — | No |
| `okText` | `string` | Text of the confirm button, such as "Delete"; the built-in "Confirm" text of the current locale by default. | — | No |
